title: Websites & Marketing for Profitable Pilates Studios — patientMoon Wellness Marketing

facts.fact: patientMoon's Start Getting More Clients offering is described as a detailed plan for bringing a studio to the next level, delivered in a 90-minute session with 2 senior team members.
facts.quote: 90 minutes. 2 senior team members. 1 strategic investment.

facts.fact: patientMoon defines CTAs on its page as calls to action that lead potential clients to take action on a website.
facts.quote: You need clear, concise, and unignorable CTAs (calls to action) — which grab your potential clients by the proverbial hand, and lead them to take action.

facts.fact: patientMoon describes Search Engine Optimization as a technical process involving content, URL, and other on-site optimizations so that people searching Google for Pilates studios find the site.
facts.quote: ensure people using Google to find Pilates studios find your site easily, using a technical process that involves content, URL, and other on-site optimizations

facts.fact: patientMoon's Initial Session offer is priced at $99 for studio owners (vendor's own offer).
patientMoon says its team has over 90 years of combined experience.
facts.quote: **With over 90 years of combined experience (yes, really), we’re truly experts at this.**

facts.fact: patientMoon's initial session lasts 90 minutes and is conducted with two of its senior team members.
facts.quote: You’re going to meet with two of our senior team members for 90 minutes.

facts.fact: patientMoon states that Gabrielle, Ryan, and Lindsay have a collective 3 decades or so of experience working with MINDBODY and other booking systems.
facts.quote: Gabrielle, Ryan, and Lindsay have a collective 3 decades or so of experience working with MINDBODY and other booking systems

facts.fact: patientMoon says it works with booking systems including MINDBODY, Acuity, Square, Jane, and Momence.
facts.quote: Whether you use MINDBODY, Acuity, Square, Jane, Momence, or another booking system, we’ll integrate and optimize your client’s online experience.

facts.fact: patientMoon states it works exclusively with Pilates studios and small wellness businesses.
facts.quote: We work exclusively with Pilates studios and small wellness businesses
